translations.web: All the people arose as one man, saying, “None of us will go to his tent, neither will any of us turn to his house.
translations.bsb: Then all the people stood as one man and said, “Not one of us will return to his tent or to his house.
translations.kjv: And all the people arose as one man, saying, We will not any of us go to his tent, neither will we any of us turn into his house.
translations.asv: And all the people arose as one man, saying, We will not any of us go to his tent, neither will we any of us turn unto his house.
